requirement: Fit a long chat history into a model's context budget by dropping the oldest turns while always keeping the system prompt and the latest message.
skeleton: A MESSAGE_OVERHEAD constant, a BudgetTooSmallError, and trim_history pricing messages with the token counter, keeping system messages, and adding newest turns until the first one that does not fit.
caption: Trimming OpenAI chat history to fit a token budget. trim_history(messages, budget, count_tokens) prices each message as count_tokens of its content plus MESSAGE_OVERHEAD 4. System messages are always kept, and it raises ValueError when there are no non-system turns. If the system messages plus the newest turn cost more than the budget it raises BudgetTooSmallError, a ValueError, saying need N tokens. It then walks older turns newest first, adding each while the running total stays within the budget and stopping at the first that does not fit so the kept history stays contiguous. It returns system messages then kept turns in original order without mutating the input. The fixture asserts the kept contents at budgets 30 and 24, that an older short turn is not resumed past a long one, that overhead is counted at budget 23, that budget 11 raises BudgetTooSmallError with need 12 tokens, and that the input is unchanged.

plan.intent: Keep long conversations under the context limit
constraints: A history without non-system turns raises ValueError
Each message costs its tokens plus MESSAGE_OVERHEAD
The newest turn is required or BudgetTooSmallError is raised
Older turns are added newest first and stop at the first misfit
The result keeps original order and the input is untouched

rationale.teaches: Trim from the oldest end with a contiguous window and per-message overhead so the request never exceeds the limit or leaves gaps in the dialogue.
rationale.why: Skipping over a large turn to pack in older ones leaves a history with holes, and ignoring per-message overhead overflows the real context window.

ops.docstring: Trim chat history to a token budget before sending it to OpenAI.

ops.source:
class BudgetTooSmallError(ValueError):
    """Raised when system messages plus the newest turn exceed the budget."""

candidates.why_wrong: Older turns are packed in after skipping one, leaving gaps in the dialogue.
A history that exactly fills the budget drops one more turn.
Per-message overhead is ignored, so the request exceeds the real budget.
Kept turns come back newest first instead of in chronological order.
An impossible budget returns a history that still overflows it.
